# CrossPoint Reader 1.5.0-34

This Xteink X4 Pro release replaces the slow software TLS download path and
keeps deleted Calibre books out of library synchronization.

## Improved

- Book synchronization and OTA downloads on X4 Pro now use ESP-IDF's native
  HTTP and mbedTLS stack with larger 8 KB receive and transfer buffers.
- Low-memory devices retain their existing wolfSSL network path.

## Fixed

- Calibre sync now ignores books inside hidden directories, including
  `.caltrash`.
- Books moved into Calibre's trash disappear from the server manifest and are
  removed from the device by the next successful full synchronization.

## Notes

- This release is published for Xteink X4 Pro only.
